Trade-offs

every evaluated variant on two weighted KPIs
  • Pareto front
  • other feasible variant
  • best by fitness
  • baseline

The Pareto front joins the feasible variants that no other feasible variant beats on both KPIs at once. The best variant by fitness need not lie on the front of every pair: the fitness weighs all KPIs.
